## Instructions

1. Toss the bread cubes with the melted butter.
2. Mix the tomatoes with the sugar, onion, salt and pepper.
3. Layer tomatoes and bread in a buttered dish, ending with bread.
4. Bake uncovered at 375 °F for 40 minutes.
